#Data Preperation
# Load packages
```{r}
#| warning: false

library(writexl)
library(haven)
library(tidyverse)
library(gtsummary)
library(broom)
library(survey)
library(mice)
library(mitools)
library(gt)
library(heiscore)
```

# Select Relevant variables needed from the NHANES data
```{r}
library(haven)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)

files <- list.files(path = "C:/Users/chris/OneDrive/Desktop/nhanes",
                    pattern = "\\.xpt$",
                    full.names = TRUE)


# Read all files and tag each with its filename/cycle
df_list <- lapply(files, function(f) {
  df <- read_xpt(f)
  df$source_file <- basename(f)  # optional: track where it came from
  return(df)
})



# --- Option 2: Merge multiple components within each cycle, then bind cycles ---
# Split files by cycle (adjust the pattern to match your naming convention)
cycle1_files <- files[grepl("_E", files)]  # e.g., 2017-2018
cycle2_files <- files[grepl("_F", files)]  # e.g., 2021-2023

read_and_merge <- function(file_list) {
  file_list <- file_list[order(!grepl("DEMO", file_list))]  # DEMO first
  dfs <- lapply(file_list, read_xpt)
  Reduce(function(a, b) full_join(a, b, by = "SEQN"), dfs)
}

# read_and_merge <- function(file_list) {
#   dfs <- lapply(file_list, read_xpt)
#   Reduce(function(a, b) full_join(a, b, by = "SEQN"), dfs)
# }

 cycle1 <- read_and_merge(cycle1_files) %>% mutate(cycle = "2007-2008")    
 cycle2 <- read_and_merge(cycle2_files) %>% mutate(cycle = "2009-2010")

nhanes_combined <- bind_rows(cycle1, cycle2) %>%
  select(
    SEQN, cycle, RIAGENDR, RIDAGEYR,
    RIDRETH1, DMDEDUC2, INDFMPIR,
    DMDEDUC3,
    CBD740, CBD745,
    BPXSY2, BPXSY3, BPXSY4,
    BPXDI2, BPXDI3, BPXDI4,
    BPQ020, BPQ050A,
    ALQ120Q, ALQ120U, ALQ130,
    SMQ020, SMQ040,
    PAQ605, PAQ610, PAD615,
    PAQ620, PAQ625, PAD630,
    PAQ635, PAQ640, PAD645,
    PAQ650, PAQ655, PAD660,
    PAQ665, PAQ670, PAD675,
    BMXBMI,
    DR1TKCAL, DR2TKCAL,
    SDMVSTRA, SDMVPSU
  ) |> 
  filter(RIDAGEYR >= 18)  
```

# Calculate HEI scores and  merge back to main dataset
```{r}
hei_0708 <- score(
  method = "simple",
  years = "0708",
  component = "total score"
)

hei_0910 <- score(
  method = "simple",
  years = "0910",
  component = "total score"
) 

hei_scores <- bind_rows(hei_0708, hei_0910) 
 

nhanes_combined <- nhanes_combined %>%
  left_join(
    hei_scores %>%
    select(SEQN, score, WTDR2D),
    by = "SEQN"
  ) |> 
   mutate(WTDR4D = WTDR2D / 2)  # adjust for combining 2 cycles
```

# Transform/combine variables 
```{r}
#Coded values in the questionnaire such as 7, 9, 777 or 999, are recoded to NA

nhanes_combined <- nhanes_combined |>
  
#Combine smoking variables into categorical, non-smoker-current
  mutate(
    
  SMQ020 = na_if(SMQ020, 7),
  SMQ020 = na_if(SMQ020, 9),
  SMQ040 = na_if(SMQ040, 7),
  
 Smoking = factor(
            case_when(
  SMQ020 == 2 ~                       "Never",
  SMQ020 == 1 & SMQ040 %in% c(1, 2) ~ "Current",
  SMQ020 == 1 & SMQ040 == 3 ~         "Former"),
 
  levels = c("Never", "Former", "Current")
        )) |> 

#Standardize all people into drinks per year, then 
#combine alcohol variables into categorical
   mutate(
    ALQ120Q = na_if(ALQ120Q, 999),
    ALQ130  = na_if(ALQ130, 999),
    
    Alc_year  = case_when(
      ALQ120Q == 0 ~ 0,
      ALQ120U == 1 ~ ALQ120Q * 52,   
      ALQ120U == 2 ~ ALQ120Q * 12,   
      ALQ120U == 3 ~ ALQ120Q * 1),

  Drinks_year = Alc_year * coalesce(ALQ130, 0), 
  Drinks_day  = Drinks_year / 365,   

  Alcohol = factor(
    case_when(
    is.na(Drinks_day) ~ NA_character_,  # keep missing as NA
    Drinks_day == 0 ~ "None",
      RIAGENDR == 1 & Drinks_day >= 15/7 ~ "Heavy", 
      RIAGENDR == 2 & Drinks_day >= 8/7  ~ "Heavy", 
      RIAGENDR == 1 & Drinks_day <= 2 ~ "Moderate", 
      RIAGENDR == 2 & Drinks_day <= 1 ~ "Moderate", 
    TRUE ~ "Moderate"),

    levels = c("None", "Moderate", "Heavy"))
  ) |> 


# Combine BP measurements  into binary hypertension variable 
 mutate(
  mean_sbp = rowMeans(cbind(BPXSY2, BPXSY3, BPXSY4), na.rm = TRUE),
  mean_dbp = rowMeans(cbind(BPXDI2, BPXDI3, BPXDI4), na.rm = TRUE),
  
  
  BPQ020 = if_else(BPQ020 %in% c(7, 9), NA_real_, BPQ020),
  BPQ050A = if_else(BPQ050A %in% c(7, 9), NA_real_, BPQ050A),
  
    Hypertension = case_when(
      mean_sbp >= 130 | 
      mean_dbp >= 80  | 
      BPQ020 == 1     | 
      BPQ050A == 1    ~ "Yes",
      TRUE            ~ "No"),
      
  Hypertension = factor(Hypertension, levels = c("No", "Yes"))) |> 
  
 mutate(
  BP_Control = case_when(
    mean_sbp >= 140 | 
    mean_dbp >= 90  | 
    BPQ020 == 1     | 
    BPQ050A == 1    ~ "Yes",
    TRUE ~ "No"
  ),
  BP_Control = factor(BP_Control, levels = c("No", "Yes"))
) |>
  
  # mutate(
  #   # 1. Create the Binary Variable
  #   BP_Control = case_when(
  #     # If they are NOT hypertensive, they aren't part of this "Control" math
  #     Hypertension == "No" ~ NA_character_,
  #     
  #     # CONTROLLED: In the club AND numbers are < 130/80 (regardless of meds)
  #     Hypertension == "Yes" & (mean_sbp < 130 & mean_dbp < 80) ~ "Controlled",
  #     
  #     # UNCONTROLLED: In the club AND numbers are >= 130 OR >= 80 (regardless of meds)
  #     Hypertension == "Yes" & (mean_sbp >= 130 | mean_dbp >= 80) ~ "Uncontrolled",
  #     
  #     # Catch missing exam data
  #     TRUE ~ NA_character_
  #   ),
  #   
  #   # 2. Make it a factor for easy plotting/tables
  #   BP_Control = factor(BP_Control, levels = c("Controlled", "Uncontrolled"))
  # ) |>

#combine all physical activity variables into total weekly minutes 
  mutate(
    # vigorous work
    PAQ610 = na_if(PAQ610, 99),
    PAD615 = na_if(PAD615, 9999),
    PAQ610_c = if_else(PAQ605 == 2, 0, PAQ610),
    PAD615_c = if_else(PAQ605 == 2, 0, PAD615),

    # moderate work
    PAQ620   = na_if(PAQ620, 9),
    PAQ625   = na_if(PAQ625, 99),
    PAD630   = na_if(PAD630, 9999),
    PAQ625_c = if_else(PAQ620 == 2, 0, PAQ625),
    PAD630_c = if_else(PAQ620 == 2, 0, PAD630),

    # walk/bike
    PAQ640   = na_if(PAQ640, 99),
    PAD645   = na_if(PAD645, 9999),
    PAQ640_c = if_else(PAQ635 == 2, 0, PAQ640),
    PAD645_c = if_else(PAQ635 == 2, 0, PAD645),

    # vigorous recreational
    PAQ650   = na_if(PAQ650, 9),
    PAD660   = na_if(PAD660, 9999),
    PAQ655_c = if_else(PAQ650 == 2, 0, PAQ655),
    PAD660_c = if_else(PAQ650 == 2, 0, PAD660),

    # moderate recreational
    PAQ670   = na_if(PAQ670, 9),
    PAD675   = na_if(PAD675, 9999),
    PAQ670_c = if_else(PAQ665 == 2, 0, PAQ670),
    PAD675_c = if_else(PAQ665 == 2, 0, PAD675),

    # minutes/week per domain
    vig_work   = PAQ610_c * PAD615_c,
    mod_work   = PAQ625_c * PAD630_c,
    walk_bike  = PAQ640_c * PAD645_c,
    vig_rec    = PAQ655_c * PAD660_c,
    mod_rec    = PAQ670_c * PAD675_c,

    # total in moderate-equivalent minutes
    Total_pa_cont   = mod_work + mod_rec + walk_bike +
                 2 * (vig_work + vig_rec),
    
    #create categorical variable for total PA
    Total_pa =cut(Total_pa_cont, 
                breaks = c(-Inf, 0, 149, 299, 599, Inf),
                labels = c("0", "1–149", "150–299", "300–599", "600+"),
                right = TRUE)) |>
  
 mutate(
   avg_kcal = rowMeans(
              across(c(DR1TKCAL, DR2TKCAL)),
              na.rm = TRUE)
   )
```

# Recode/Collapse Variables
```{r}
#This section only recode variables from numeric to factors/character and/or
#collapse multiple categorical levels into fewer levels

nhanes_combined <- nhanes_combined |>
  rename(ID  = SEQN) |>
  rename(Age = RIDAGEYR) |>
  rename(Htn_diag = BPQ020) |>
  rename(Meds = BPQ050A) |> 

 mutate(

   Gender = factor(
            recode(RIAGENDR,
                            `1` = "Male",
                            `2` = "Female"),
            levels = c("Male", "Female")),
    
 
    Race = fct_collapse(
                as.factor(RIDRETH1),
                              White    = "3",
                              Black    = "4",
                              Hispanic = c("1", "2"),
                              Other    = "5")
            |> fct_relevel("White"),
   
    # educ_combined = coalesce(          #combine both education varibles into 1
    #   na_if(na_if(DMDEDUC2, 7), 9), DMDEDUC3),
   
    educ_combined = coalesce(
  na_if(na_if(DMDEDUC2, 7), 9),
  na_if(DMDEDUC3, 99)
),
   
    Education = fct_collapse(
      as.factor(educ_combined),
               "Less than HS"     = c("1", "2", "9", "10", "11", "12", "66"),  
               "High School/GED"  = c("3", "13", "14"),
               "College or above" = c("4", "5", "15")),               
      

    RIncomePov = cut(INDFMPIR,
                          breaks = c(-Inf, 1.00, 1.99, 3.99, Inf),
                          labels = c("<1.00", "1.00–1.99", 
                                     "2.00–3.99", ">4.00"),
                          right = TRUE),
  
    Buy_org = factor(
              recode(
              na_if(na_if(CBD740, 3), 9),  
                                `1` = "Yes",
                                `2` = "No"),
              levels = c("No", "Yes")),

    
    CBD745_c = if_else(CBD740 == 2, 5L,  # converts Buy_org No responses into 
               na_if(CBD745, 9)),       #Never for Freq_buy_org
            
    
    Freq_Buy_org = fct_collapse(
                    as.factor(CBD745_c),   
                              "Always/Most" = c("1", "2"),
                               Sometimes    = "3",
                               Rarely       = "4",
                               Never        = "5")
   |> fct_relevel("Never", "Rarely", "Sometimes", "Always/Most"),
                            
                          
    BMI = cut(BMXBMI, 
                        breaks = c(-Inf, 25, 30, Inf), 
                        labels = c("Normal/Underweight",  
                                   "Overweight", "Obese"), 
                        right  = TRUE)
       )
```

# Multiple Imputation 
```{r}
set.seed(123)

# Define methods for imputation: "" = do not impute
meth <- make.method(nhanes_final)
meth["Education"]  <- "polyreg"
meth["Smoking"]    <- "polyreg"
meth["Alcohol"]    <- "polyreg"  # depends on how many categories
meth["Total_pa"]   <- "polyreg"  # depends
meth["RIncomePov"] <- "polyreg"
meth["Freq_Buy_org"] <- "polyreg"
meth["BMI"]          <- "polyreg"

where <- make.where(nhanes_final)
where[nhanes_final$cycle == "2009-2010", "Freq_Buy_org"] <- FALSE    

mi <- mice::mice(nhanes_final, m = 10, method = meth, where = where, seed = 123)

all_imputations <- imputationList(complete(mi, "all"))

mi_data <- svydesign(
  id = ~SDMVPSU,         
  strata = ~SDMVSTRA,    
  weights = ~WTDR4D,   
  data = all_imputations,
  nest = TRUE
)
```

# Log model for organic food purchase (yes/no)
```{r}
#| warning: false

# Run all models (unpooled)
models <- list(
  
model_0 = with(mi_data, svyglm(
  Hypertension ~ Buy_org, family = binomial())),

model_1 = with(mi_data, svyglm(
    Hypertension ~ Buy_org + Gender + Race + Age + Education + RIncomePov,
  family = binomial())),

model_2 = with(mi_data, svyglm(
    Hypertension ~ Buy_org + Gender + Race + Age + Total_pa + Education + 
    RIncomePov + Smoking + Alcohol + BMI + avg_kcal + score, 
  family = binomial()))
  )

# Pool all models
pooled <- lapply(models, MIcombine)
```

#Extract values needed to create odds table
```{r}
extract_1 <- function(micombine_obj, variable = "Buy_org") {

  # extract coefficients & vcov
  est <- micombine_obj$coefficients
  se  <- sqrt(diag(micombine_obj$variance))

  # find correct row (Buy_orgYes)
  idx <- which(names(est) == variable)

  # compute CI + OR
  OR  <- exp(est[idx])
  lower <- exp(est[idx] - 1.96 * se[idx])
  upper <- exp(est[idx] + 1.96 * se[idx])
  pval <- 2 * pnorm(abs(est[idx]/se[idx]), lower.tail = FALSE)

  data.frame(
    OR = OR,
    CI = sprintf("%.2f–%.2f", lower, upper),
    p = sprintf("%.3f", pval)
  )
}
```

#Extract values needed to create odds table for frequency of organic food purchase
```{r}
extract_2 <- function(micombine_obj, variable = "Freq_Buy_org") {
  est <- micombine_obj$coefficients
  se  <- sqrt(diag(micombine_obj$variance))
  nm  <- names(est)

  idx <- grep(paste0("^", gsub("([\\W])", "\\\\\\1", variable)), nm)
  if (!length(idx)) stop("No coefficients found for variable: ", variable)

  OR    <- exp(est[idx])
  lower <- exp(est[idx] - 1.96 * se[idx])
  upper <- exp(est[idx] + 1.96 * se[idx])
  pval  <- 2 * pnorm(abs(est[idx] / se[idx]), lower.tail = FALSE)

  lvl <- sub(paste0("^", variable), "", nm[idx])
  lvl <- sub("^[:= ]+", "", lvl)

  data.frame(
    Level = lvl,
    OR = OR,
    CI = sprintf("%.2f–%.2f", lower, upper),
    p = sprintf("%.3f", pval),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}
```

table_2 <- bind_rows(

  extract_1(pooled$model_1, "Buy_orgYes") |> mutate(Model = "Model 1"),
  extract_1(pooled$model_2, "Buy_orgYes") |> mutate(Model = "Model 2")
) |>
  
select(Model, OR, CI, p) |>
mutate(Model = factor(Model, levels = c("Crude", "Model 1", "Model 2"))) |>
  
gt(rowname_col = "Model") |>   # <-- make Model the stub
tab_header(
  title = md("**Table 2. Association between organic food purchase and 
             hypertension, NHANES 2007–2010.**")
) |>
cols_label(
  OR = "Odds Ratio (OR)",
  CI = "95% (CI)",
  p  = "P-value"
) |>
fmt_number(
  columns = vars(OR),
  decimals = 2
) |>
cols_align(
  align = "center",
  columns = everything()
) |>
  
tab_footnote(
  footnote = paste(
    "Model 1: adjusted for gender, race, age, education, and ratio of family 
    income to poverty."),
  locations = cells_stub(rows = "Model 1")
) |>
tab_footnote(
  footnote = paste(
    "Model 2: adjusted for model 1 plus total physical activity, smoking, 
    alcohol, and BMI."),
  locations = cells_stub(rows = "Model 2")
)

table_2 <- table_2 |> 
  tab_options(
    table.border.top.width = 0,
    table.border.bottom.width = 0,
    column_labels.border.bottom.width = 0,
    table_body.hlines.width = 0,   # remove horizontal lines between rows
    table_body.vlines.width = 0,   # remove vertical lines
    table.font.size = "small",     # optional, smaller font
    heading.padding = px(2),
    data_row.padding = px(2)
  ) 
 


table_2
